summary: OpenAI announced that ChatGPT can now connect to EHR systems and other healthcare industry data sources, allowing clinicians to access patient context and medical research within the product.

categories.reason: The product now connects to electronic health record and clinical data sources to support clinician workflows, crossing into clinical/care use.
categories.quote: ChatGPT can now connect to trusted healthcare data, helping clinicians securely access patient context, medical research, and more.

practices.reason: A new connector to EHR and healthcare data sources creates integration work for teams building clinical or health-adjacent products on ChatGPT.
practices.quote: Healthcare organizations can now connect EHR and additional industry data to ChatGPT.
